description: Run JavaScript in an agent tab (isolated from the page's own scripts, same DOM) and return its value: a promise's, awaited up to 20 s, when the script is one expression (an async IIFE) or uses await and ends in return. Prefer snapshot and click. A click, submit or Enter in it on a Send, Pay, Delete or like button waits for the user's yes, as click does, and is made after the script. Send, pay or delete through the page's own buttons, never around them with fetch or a URL.
